svg.title: Mobility Decision Copilot high-level architecture
svg.desc: A shareable high-level design showing personas and triggers, a Java and React application boundary, DuckDB analytics, four controlled agents, approval and outputs, PostgreSQL control state, and cross-cutting observability, evaluation, and security.
svg.text: Agentic intelligence and reporting layer for enterprise mobility
evidence references + decisions only • no raw trip/leg replication
initialize → authorize → profile → metrics → anomaly → prioritize
merge evidence → verify arithmetic/provenance → qualify or abstain
Provider adapter • structured outputs • model/prompt versions
Shared by all four logical roles; roles are not separate deployed services
Report-only path when action is ineligible
Applied across the API, analytical and agent planes
Diagnostic observability — not the audit ledger
PII masking • least privilege • tool allowlist
AWS API Gateway / workers as target
Core principle: deterministic code owns facts, policy and actions; LLM agents own bounded semantic reasoning.
